Professor Zulfiqar Bhutta receives the award from the Premier of Ontario, Hon. Kathleen Wynne. Samir Dossal, President, CPBC can also be seen in the photo.

content.text: Professor Zulfiqar Bhutta, Founding Director of the Centre of Excellence in Women and Child Health at the Aga Khan University and Co-Director at the Center for Global Child Health at The Hospital for Sick Children received the Canada-Pakistan Business Council's Achievement Award for the Professional of the Year - Male 2015, from the Premier of Ontario, Hon. Kathleen Wynne.
The award was presented on the occasion of the CPBC's 32nd Anniversary Gala Dinner and Awards Night on June 1 in Ontario, Canada.

CPBC's Achievement Award is presented to individuals committed to excellence in their chosen fields. Professor Bhutta has been selected as the Professional of the Year - Male 2015, for his research in maternal and child health. The award specifically recognized his work done in Canada over the last few years in promoting global newborn and child health, and actions to address issues relevant to Pakistan and developing countries.
CPBC is a non-profit organization that aims to promote trade between Canada and Pakistan.
